decision.rationale: MedNet is an official public resource and updates site for UBC Faculty of Medicine faculty and staff across the province. Public support guidance is its primary purpose; explicit news, event and personal-spotlight sections warrant separate categories. The homepage is not authentication-only or exclusively Okanagan-serving.

rules.rationale: Faculty and staff spotlights and one-on-one profiles recount individual experiences.
The homepage names these personal profiles and spotlight series.
The event calendar provides opportunities to attend Faculty of Medicine talks and activities.
Explicit news, honours and update sections report faculty developments and announcements.
These titles appear in the homepage's What's New announcements.
